arguments.body:
**Date:** April 17, 2023

The second post-ship cohort recorded week-1 retention of **+1.4 points versus baseline**, below the April 10 cohort's +3.2 points and the pooled experiment read of +3.1 points. The temporary dip was traced to an approximately **36-hour outage** in the separate Customer Success auto-onboarding-nudge system. With that nudge unavailable, some mid-segment accounts activated later; the activation-event email still sent, but at the wrong point in the sequence, shifting activation timing and creating a one-time cohort artifact.

This was not a failure of `lifecycle_onboarding_trigger_v2` or its experiment logic. The trigger remained at 100% and its experiment checks were clean. After the incident, the CS auto-onboarding-nudge system was back up. The observed dip was therefore attributed to the temporary CS-side interruption, not a regression in the onboarding-trigger rollout.
